title: ProgressionBoarder
description: Powerful zone/border control—restrict, protect, and guide players with clear rules and feedback.
body:
# ProgressionBoarder

ProgressionBoarder draws hard boundaries where you need them: event arenas, cities, dungeons, restricted zones, or story areas with strict rules. Players get clear visual feedback, and you can precisely control what’s allowed (pass through, interact, block) — including bypass permissions for staff. Perfect if your world should feel designed and controlled, not just big.

Want event arenas that can’t be griefed? Want story areas with rules? Want clean “do not enter” zones that actually work? ProgressionBoarder gives you strong control over areas, with predictable restriction logic and player feedback—built for real admin use, not gimmicks.

# Highlights:

Create/manage borders and zones with clear behavior

Restrict interactions/movement where needed

Staff bypass support for controlled moderation

Ideal for events, dungeons, cities, and protected areas

Perfect for: admin control, events, protected builds, guided gameplay.

# Why you’ll love it

Stops griefing and unwanted interactions in protected areas

Perfect for events, story zones, dungeon entrances, cities

Clear rules + predictable behavior (admin-friendly)

# Features

Create borders/zones with rule sets

Restrict movement/interactions where needed

Visual feedback and staff bypass support

Built for controlled gameplay areas

# Setup

Install the plugin

Define/create borders in-game

Configure restrictions + bypass permissions

Test player behavior near borders

# Compatibility

Platform: Paper / Spigot (Paper recommended)

Great for: event servers, RPG hubs, protected builds
